mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1.2M & UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) during a recession signals further economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising real GDP (GDPC1) indicates supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < -1% MoM & GDPC1 > 2% YoY.
